audit.whatIsWrong: All seven full-layer phases[].side read "Skill" while content win[] and packet.levelChart both read Ekko/Skill/Skill/Ekko/Akali/Ekko/Ekko.
audit.why: Two sources agree against one field. The shape is also correct on the kits: Akali's Q costs 110 energy at rank 1 so she cannot answer strings early, and Perfect Execution at 6 is her one clean window.
audit.corrected: phases[0]=Ekko, [1]/[2] stay Skill, [3]=Ekko, [4]=Akali, [5]/[6]=Ekko, each with a why rewritten to argue the same verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4] rated 6/10 in Ekko's favour on the level the content layer awards to Akali, and breakdown.spikes was the generic three-clause template.
audit.why: Level 6 is Akali's peak: Perfect Execution is 120s at rank 1 but its recast executes, and Twilight Shroud hides the setup.
audit.corrected: phases[4] moved to Akali at 4/10; spikes rewritten to energy (3-5) / Perfect Execution (6) / first item.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two interactions never stated: Shuriken Flip's shuriken marks "the first enemy or smoke cloud hit", so Akali can mark her own Twilight Shroud and dash back into it; and Assassin's Mark's ring empowers her next attack when she leaves it, so her combo opens on an auto-attack reset — the wind-up is the tell, not the cast.
audit.why: Both are in Riot's own text and neither appears anywhere on the page; the second is exactly the missingInteractions entry for this matchup.
audit.corrected: Written into tradeBad, enemyWin, report[5], dontsFull[2] and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT), and dosFull[2].d called Shroud a "fifteen-second invitation".
audit.why: Twilight Shroud is 20/19/18/17/16, not 15. Shuriken Flip is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10; Chronobreak is 110/80/50.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[2].d, report[5] and loading.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8].t said "Add anti-heal early into his sustain." Akali has no healing anywhere in her kit.
audit.why: Her passive is an empowered attack, not a heal — Grievous Wounds buys nothing in this lane.
audit.corrected: Replaced with Zhonya's as the answer to Perfect Execution.
sources: enemyKit P/Q/W/E/R — no heal flag anywhere

notes:
CHART: all seven full-layer phases[].side read 'Skill' while content win[] and packet.levelChart agreed on Ekko/Skill/Skill/Ekko/Akali/Ekko/Ekko — a cross-layer disagreement on five rows. I moved the full layer onto the content layer, so no win[N] edits were possible (before would equal after). Every side edit ships with its .why rewritten; ratings moved only where the verdict moved.

ADDED INTERACTIONS: Shuriken Flip marks 'the first enemy or smoke cloud hit', so Akali can mark her own Twilight Shroud and dash back into it — this is why blinking in on her E is the losing trade. Assassin's Mark's ring means her combo opens on an empowered auto, so the wind-up is the tell (the missingInteractions entry).

FIXED FACTUAL ERRORS: dosFull[2].d said Shroud was a 'fifteen-second invitation' (it is 20/19/18/17/16); report[8].t told the reader to buy anti-heal 'into his sustain' when Akali's kit contains no healing at all.

REPORT SWEEP: two substantive rewrites only — report[5] and report[8]. report[0]/[1]/[3]/[4]/[9]/[11] are lint-mandated pronoun corrections carried in step with their source fields, not sweep expansions.

LEFT ALONE (templated, nothing enemy-specific available without inventing): breakdown.mid, breakdown.late, breakdown.feeding, report[10], content late and mid.

UNVERIFIED, not written: whether Ekko's Parallel Convergence anomaly still stuns Akali while she is inside Twilight Shroud (Riot's text says 'unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks', which does not settle whether a non-targeted zone applies). I wrote 'unselectable' and nothing stronger.
